name: Langfuse Observability
description: Trace OpenClaw agent runs, model calls, tools, and subagents to Langfuse.

enabled.description: Enable Langfuse tracing. LANGFUSE_OPENCLAW_ENABLED takes precedence.

publicKey.description: Langfuse public key. Falls back to LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY.

secretKey.description: Langfuse secret key. Falls back to LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.

baseUrl.description: Langfuse host. Falls back to LANGFUSE_BASE_URL.

captureInput.description: Capture prompts, history, and tool parameters.

captureOutput.description: Capture model responses and tool results.

redactSensitiveData.description: Redact values whose field names look like credentials.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters retained for each captured string.
